sentences.text:
Coram: - Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath
-----

For the Petitioner : Ms. Nivedita Kundu, Advocate For the State : Mr. Azeemuddin, A.P.P.
---
02/07.11.2025 Heard the parties.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with S.T. Case No.25 of 2022 arising out of Khunti (M) P.S. Case No. 20 of 2020, for the offences registered under Sections 376(1)/417 of the I.P.C., pending in the court of learned D.A.S.J.-I, Khunti.
On the pretext of marriage, the petitioner is alleged to have established consensual physical relationship with the prosecutrix, who is a major lady.
Later on, the petitioner refused to marry her.
It was submitted that parties were in consensual physical relationship since last two years.
In view of the submissions made above, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly,
the petitioner, above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.
20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned D.A.S.J.-I, Khunti, in connection with S.T. Case No.25 of 2022 arising out of Khunti (M)
P.S. Case No. 20 of 2020.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) 7th November, 2025 Jay/-
